context: Two teens plan a movie night
purpose: Teach: ミラノ/アラビア/薔薇/カジノ/リッチ/紀行/馬券/キューバ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今夜の映画、ミラノが舞台のラブストーリー、観たい。
lines.en: There's this movie tonight — a love story set in Milan. You want to watch it?
lines.style: Leaning forward with genuine enthusiasm. Light, quick cadence. Testing whether he'll bite. Wanting him to want this too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。アラビア風の装飾、雰囲気あるって聞いた。
lines.en: Yeah, that sounds good. I heard the set design — all those Arabian touches — really pulls you in.
lines.style: Nodding agreement. Tone neutral-warm, like he's already settling into the idea. Slight emphasis on the design detail, showing he's been thinking about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 劇中の薔薇園、ロケが本格的。
lines.en: And the rose garden in it? They actually filmed on location. It's real.
lines.style: Voice lifting on 'rose garden' — she's sharing something she's excited about. Quick, animated rhythm. Wants him to know this isn't just any film.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: カジノのシーン、緊張感あるよな。
lines.en: The casino sequences do hit different. There's real tension in them.
lines.style: Quieter observation, like he's turning it over. Slight smirk in the delivery — half-dry, half-genuine. Leaning back a little.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 主人公、最初はリッチな暮らしから始まる紀行映画なの。
lines.en: Okay, so the main character starts out living this rich life — the whole film is kind of a journey, you know?
lines.style: Checking his face as she explains. Slightly apologetic tone, like she's making sure he gets why this matters. Patient. Deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 馬券で大勝ちする場面、ちょっと痛快。
lines.en: There's this scene where he wins big at the betting tables. It's genuinely satisfying.
lines.style: Slight brightness returning. Sharing a moment of pleasure in the story. Leaning in conspiratorially — like they're in on the good part together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 終盤、キューバへ移動する展開、ドラマチック。
lines.en: And then toward the end, he leaves for Cuba. It shifts everything.
lines.style: Finishing strong. Voice steady and open. The kind of closer that invites him to ask more. No apology, no trailing off.
